attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Creator of a document; initial value is the Creator; authors have read/write permissions on the document and details like attachments and change proposals.

attributes.name: coauthor
attributes.description: Additional personal change rights; co-authors can be assigned; not part of the release workflow.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Users or groups with read access to the document; distributions control access.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Document checker in the release workflow; can be assigned as a reviewer.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Document approver; decides distribution to readers; has release permissions.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Document versioning and revision; new version created for content or attribute changes.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Document status (e.g., editing, released) as part of the versioning workflow.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Types of documents with abbreviations and numbering
